# Kautusang Bayan No. 01, Series of 1998

**Additional Appropriations Ordinance**

## Summary

This ordinance approves and allocates an additional appropriation of ₱358,716.75 from the unappropriated balance of the Annual Budget 1998 as of December 31, 1997, for essential needs and expenses of the local government of Pitogo, Quezon. The ordinance was enacted by the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] of Pitogo, Quezon on March 9, 1998.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1.** Allocates ₱358,716.75 from the unappropriated balance or surplus of the Annual Budget 1998 as of December 31, 1997, for essential needs and expenses of the local government of Pitogo, Quezon.
2.  **Section 2.** States that the Additional Appropriations Ordinance No. 01, Series of 1998, prepared by the Honorable Mayor, is included and considered an integral part of the ordinance, marked as "Annex A."
3.  **Section 3.** Stipulates that the Municipal Ordinance on Additional Appropriations takes effect upon its approval.
4.  **Section 4.** Declares the ordinance approved on March 9, 1998, in Pitogo, Quezon.
